name: sealed-panel
description: Grade a text with blind panels of fresh LLM judges and a sealed final panel, never by its author.

transcript_root.title: Judge transcript folder
transcript_root.description: The folder where the host writes its session and subagent transcripts: ~/.claude/projects under your home, or the projects folder of your configuration directory if you moved it. The record tool reads a judge's transcript as proof only there. Change it later in this plugin's settings (/config). Left empty, transcripts are refused, and replies are pasted (flagged in the report) or come from a judge command.
